added_findings.title: Thumbnail capture signature differs: ported TV editors cannot take the Update picture, and VV's batch thumbnails already fail
added_findings.detail:
The two apps' Na__PresentationMode__Thumbnail__CaptureAndUpload take different arguments:
- TV: (sceneId, targetWidthPx), writing through Na__CfApi__WriteThumbnailWebp.
- VV: (sceneId, projectCode, showToast), which returns { ok:false, error:'missing scene id or project code' } when no project code is passed.
TV's 2.x editors call it with the scene id only. Ported whole (WP-08), every Update would toast 'Thumbnail upload failed' and leave the card's picture unchanged. The survey's name-only import check cannot see this; sigcheck.py (parameter counts) found it.
The same fault is already live in VV: VV's ported Presentation Scenes batch op calls it with one argument, and that op is wired to Update All Thumbnails. By code reading, every batch thumbnail fails in VV today. Not run.
added_findings.recommendation: Make VV's CaptureAndUpload accept TV's call shape. When the second argument is not a string, resolve the project code itself (Na__PresentationMode__ProjectJson__GetActiveProjectCode, falling back to Na__AppUtils__GetProjectCodeFromUrl), and treat a numeric second argument as targetWidthPx. Keep (sceneId, projectCode, showToast) working for ScenePersistence, ThumbnailBake and the 1.x editors. This fixes VV's Update All Thumbnails now, and lets TV's editors (and TV's scene editor) port verbatim. Land it before WP-08. Ask Adam to confirm the batch failure with one press on localhost, before and after.
added_findings.vv_adaptation: Transport stays VV's: Na__AppUtils__R2AssetUpload to PresentationMode/Thumbnails/<scene id>.webp, R2 first then the Flask mirror.

added_findings.title: Shared service-worker token must be bumped for the renumber and every export-changing S02a WP
added_findings.detail:
In production, VV's shell JS and CSS are served stale-while-revalidate by the shared WebApps worker, keyed on PWA_SW_VERSION_TOKEN ('2026-09-18-1', WCP/02__Src__AppModules/62__Feature__AppInstallability/Whitecardopedia__Pwa__ServiceWorker__Logic__.js:229). The VV ledger (lines 161-175) records four VV releases that added cross-module exports without a bump.
Every S02a WP adds or moves exports, and WP-01 moves about 70 module paths. Until its next load, a warm client can run an old cached index.html or LE module that imports a path or name that no longer exists.
TV bumped its own worker token for v2.86.0 for exactly this reason (devlog: 'Service worker token 2026-09-20-3: new exports on files a warm cache already holds').
added_findings.recommendation: Each S02a WP records 'token needed' in its devlog entry. Bump the token once per VV release wave that ships them. It is Adam's call, because the token evicts every Vale app's caches (D-S09-06). The renumber release must not ship without the bump.
added_findings.evidence: WCP/.../Whitecardopedia__Pwa__ServiceWorker__Logic__.js:229; VV/ValeVision__PARITY__TrueVisionLedger__.md:161-175; TV devlog v2.86.0 Files list (line ~7914); S09 D-S09-06.
